Facts: Using aluminum-containing leavening agent (aluminum baking powder) in food (steamed buns) despite knowing it is prohibited. Detected high aluminum residues. This is a food safety violation. In Chinese criminal law, the offense is "生产、销售假药" no. Not that. For food safety, there is "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (production and sale of food that does not meet safety standards) or "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" (production and sale of toxic or harmful food). The correct label from earlier examples: For case of selling health product with sildenafil, they used "生产、销售有毒、有害食品". For case of selling fake medicine, they used "生产、销售假药". For case of selling counterfeit alcohol, they used "假冒注册商标". For case of illegal food additive, the appropriate charge is "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". In earlier examples, there is a case: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" appears in the example about processing dead dogs? Actually that example: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" was used for dog meat processing. So that is the label.

Thus the charge: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Possibly also "非法添加食品添加剂" but the standard criminal charge is "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". So single charge.
